description: Pure-QoE reward profile for scripts/dp_oracle.py: quality (w_vmaf*VMAF) - stall (w_stall) - switch (w_switch*|dVMAF|). w_rung=0: the artificial linear rung prior (a label-balancing hack for the abandoned macro-F1 framing) is REMOVED so the oracle = standard ABR QoE ceiling (max quality without stalling). Rung diversity in the dataset now comes from the linkRate-sweep network conditions, not an artificial bitrate penalty. Conservative throughput planning (throughput_planning_factor) for buffer transitions.
